Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the [targetrivalname.GetName].

Why did you distract us?

Ah, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia. We have delayed release until the moment was ripe. Your colony on [target_planet.GetName] - it is the ideal recipient. Its biosphere will be subsumed momentarily.

texts.zh:
[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]已经完成了对[root.GetName]的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

在整个星球上，当地的昆虫现在开始使用与我们无线设备相同的频率进行通信。一声虫鸣就能操作自动门，成群的虫群甚至能使一座工厂瘫痪。我们正在通过切换频率来应对，但并非所有设施都能恢复到完全效率。
texts.en:
The [fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName] has completed its modifications on [root.GetName]. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, the local insects now communicate using the same frequencies as our wireless devices. A single chirp can operate an automatic door, and a swarm can incapacitate a factory. We are adapting by switching frequencies, but not all facilities will be returned to full efficiency.

在整个星球上，那些曾经只知道吃草和泥浴的生物现在开始向我们提出关于存在本质的令人不安的问题。失落帝国改变了这个世界上大量野生动物的天性。

The [fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName] has completed its modifications on [root.GetName]. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, creatures once content with grazing and mud baths now confront us with unsettling questions about existence. The Fallen Empire has tampered with large swathes of the world's fauna.

texts.en:
The [fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName] has completed its modifications on [root.GetName]. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

The world is shining. Literally. The modifications have somehow provided the world's varied species with a bioluminescent glow and an incessant hum like that of a running engine. Our [owner.GetColonistPlural] no longer get to experience a true night cycle, we will need to provide them with blackout equipment.

summary.text:
# 生态系统升级 / Ecosystem Upgrade

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list (weight 30 of 980); events/biogenesis_events.txt:7844-8179 · DLC: BioGenesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

“生长”碎片存在、我方和平且拥有两个以上人口超过1000的非城市宜居星球时，五年随机脉冲可能抽中 bio.3200，立即弹出 bio.3205。触发后设置2560天的蜂巢失落帝国事件冷却（hive_fallen_empire_event_cooldown），期间其他碎片要求不再出现。

With the Growth fragment present, our empire at peace and more than two non-urban habitable worlds with over 1000 pops, the five-year pulse can pick bio.3200, which shows bio.3205 at once. Firing sets a 2560-day cooldown (hive_fallen_empire_event_cooldown) shared by the fragment demands.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

生长碎片把我方误认作送生物质的竞争者，随即宣布要在我方一颗殖民地上释放封存千年的基因样式。接受（或改指另一颗星球）后，360–720天后该星球触发“生物圈已改造”bio.3210。

The Growth fragment first mistakes us for a rival late with a biomass delivery, then announces it will release a long-stored genome on one of our colonies. If we accept (or offer another planet), Biosphere Modified bio.3210 fires on that planet 360-720 days later.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

bio.3210 随机得到三种结果之一：昆虫用无线电频率交流（接受或清除）、动物获得智慧（新增500人口）、整个世界发光嗡鸣（接受或砍伐覆盖）。拒绝 bio.3205 则只降低该碎片好感，没有后续。

bio.3210 gives one of three random results: insects talking on radio frequencies (accept or purge), animals gaining sapience (500 new pops), or a glowing, humming world (accept or cover it up). Refusing in bio.3205 only lowers the fragment's opinion, with no sequel.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

环保主义帝国不能接受改造，只能愤怒拒绝；地貌改造者帝国有专属的接受选项；空中更新机械帝国清除昆虫的选项不同；杀戮型帝国面对新智慧生物的回答不同。

Environmentalist empires cannot accept and only refuse angrily; Planetscaper empires get their own accept options; Over-the-Air-update machines purge the bugs differently; homicidal empires answer the new sapients differently.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对两窗口的条件选项与随机结果权重。
  Checked conditional options of both windows and the random result weights.
